summary: Complete mobile responsiveness and logo integration testing for Petal & Paw ecommerce website. All tests passed - logo displays correctly in navbar and footer on both mobile and desktop. All pages are fully mobile responsive with no horizontal scrolling issues.
passed_tests: Logo integration: Navbar logo (/assets/logo.png) visible on desktop (h-12) and mobile (h-10)
Logo integration: Footer logo (/assets/logo.png) visible on both viewports with invert filter
HomePage - Hero: No text overlap on mobile (390px), title readable, CTA button visible
HomePage - Promise strip: Stacks vertically on mobile (flex-col sm:flex-row)
HomePage - Feature sections: Stack properly on mobile with lg:grid-cols-2
HomePage - Featured products: 2-column grid on mobile, 4 on desktop
ShopPage: Filter buttons wrap properly (flex-wrap), search bar fits
ShopPage: Product grid shows 2 cols mobile, 4 cols desktop (grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4)
ProductPage: Image and details stack vertically on mobile (grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2)
ProductPage: Text sizes readable, add-to-cart button full width on mobile
SubscriptionPage: Plan cards stack vertically on mobile (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3)
SubscriptionPage: Pet toy toggle usable (308px width on mobile)
BouquetBuilder: Step indicator fits on mobile (28px circles with 24px connectors)
BouquetBuilder: Size buttons stack on mobile (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3)
BouquetBuilder: Form elements usable, safety notice visible
CartPage: Cart items stack properly on mobile
CartPage: Order summary accessible, delivery date picker and referral code work
BlogPage: Blog cards stack on mobile (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3)
Mobile navbar: Hamburger menu visible, Sheet opens with all nav links
Mobile navbar: Navigation via hamburger menu works correctly
Mobile footer: 2-column grid on mobile, 4-column on desktop
Desktop regression: Shop 4-col grid, Subscriptions 3-col, Bouquet 3-col sizes
Desktop regression: Hamburger hidden, desktop nav links visible
No horizontal scroll issues on any page at 390px mobile viewport

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All 24 mobile responsiveness and logo tests passed

context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile responsiveness and logo integration verified for iteration 3. All pages (HomePage, ShopPage, ProductPage, SubscriptionPage, BouquetBuilder, CartPage, BlogPage, AccountPage) are fully responsive. Navbar logo at /assets/logo.png renders correctly. Mobile hamburger menu with shadcn Sheet component works properly. Footer uses 2-col grid on mobile, 4-col on desktop. No accessibility or layout issues found.
